findings: Sticker position is page-relative, not memory-relative — stickers are appended to .page-left/.page-right with left/top % relative to the page container. When a memory is drag-repositioned (applyOffsets applies CSS translate to the .memory-item), the sticker stays at its original page coordinate and appears detached. Fix: append sticker elements to their .memory-item[data-mem-id] instead, storing coordinates relative to that element.

Sticker picker deselect is broken — buildStickerPicker's click handler removes 'selected' from all options (including the clicked span) before calling toggle. Toggle then always re-adds it, making deselection impossible. The 'click again to deselect' UI hint is false. Fix: use a conditional instead of forEach+toggle.

640ms timeout vs 650ms CSS animation — isAnimating clears 10ms before the animation ends. renderSpread replaces the DOM before the clear so there is nothing to interact with during the window, but aligning the timeout to 650ms or 660ms removes the theoretical race.
